title: Little Alien | An AI Surreal Video 4K
description:
I had made this "Little Alien" song a while back but never used it for anything. Made this video for it this weekend. I wanted to try to do a story but it just wouldn’t come out right. The song is about being a kid and feeling so different from everyone else and feeling out of place, like a little alien. And they tell you you will grow out of it but sometimes you don’t. I think so many of us have felt this way at some point in our lives. Images: #Midjourney Animation #VEO3 and song @sunomusic

👉 If you like my work, I post new AI art and cinematic videos daily — subscribe to follow the journey.

#ai #aiart #aivideo #aimusic #suno #aiimages #littlealien
